verdicts_or_reports.expected: Available: 40% because actual expenses total $60 out of $100.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Available percentage is 20% and spent is $80, while history and Analytics show $60. The recurring $20 template is included in addition to the paid occurrence.
steps: Start with $100 budget, yesterday Groceries $40 and monthly Rent $20.
Tap Today budget pill on main screen.
Dismiss by tapping outside the sheet, reopen, and observe the same percentage.
Open Analytics and compare Total Spent 60; history also has only Groceries $40 and Rent $20.

verdicts_or_reports.element: Amount while entering a new category
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Typing QA456 in New category edits only the category name; amount remains empty.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Typing digits in the focused New category field closes category editing and enters those digits into the expense amount. Also reproduced with QA Test & 123.
steps: Enable Settings > Extra features > Save categories on their own.
Type QA456 into the focused category text field.
Observe amount becomes $456 instead of remaining empty.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: After entering 1.23, extra fractional digits are rejected; one backspace should change visible amount to 1.2.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The keypad accepts an invisible third fractional digit. Entering 1.234 displays $1.23; backspace leaves $1.23 unchanged because it deletes the hidden 4. Reproduced in both category modes.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Categories remains the selected tab after device rotation.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Selecting Categories then rotating resets the selected tab to Trend. Reproduced on two rotation cycles.
steps: Rotate to landscape; Trend is selected again.
Rotate portrait and repeat; selection is lost again.

sign_off.notes: Swept main expense input/save, history edit/delete/undo and section toggles, budget sheet totals/split modes/edit cancellation, category creation/list selection/sorting/deletion/persistence, navigation and rotation. History final-section collapse bug confirmed and logged. Budget Spent $80 versus actual $60, hidden fractional keypad/backspace behavior, category numeric typing, and Analytics rotation selection loss were reported but developer could not reproduce. Removed temporary expenses/categories; original Groceries $40, recurring Rent $20, Food/Transport and $100 period preserved; experimental switches restored. Separate category management route was not identifiable; tested available inline, popup, and grid category controls.
